description: This file defines an Angular standalone component named TicketConfirmationComponent which displays a confirmation message for a ticket order, including order details, total, line items, and an action button to restart the process. It serves as a UI component in a conference ticketing application.

classes.name: TicketConfirmationComponent
classes.description: Angular component that presents a modal-like confirmation UI after a ticket purchase, showing order details and a 'start over' button.

methods.name: startOver.emit
methods.description: Emits an event to signal that the user wants to restart the ticket selection process.
